message: Link text "link" doesn't say where it goes
hint: Read alone, as screen readers list links, it means nothing. Name the destination, e.g. "Read the spring guide".
A look can't come from the ESP: td;dr needs it to lower the layout. Pick between fixed looks with data-email-if / -unless twins.
td;dr lowers this element to table markup and keeps only the attributes it needs. Put the field where it stays: text, a link's href, an image's src or alt, or an attribute of a text-level element.
